paragraphs.text: translated by
1. LIKE birds who keep their watch, plashing in water, like the loud voices of the thundering rain-cloud,
paragraphs.original: उदप्रुतो न वयो रक्षमाणा वावदतो अभ्रियस्येव घोषाः ।
paragraphs.translit: udapruto na vayo rakṣamāṇā vāvadato abhriyasyeva ghoṣāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Like merry streamlets bursting from the mountain, thus to Brhaspati our hymns have sounded.
paragraphs.original: गिरिभ्रजो नोर्मयो मदन्तो बृहस्पतिमभ्यर्का अनावन्
paragraphs.translit: giribhrajo normayo madanto bṛhaspatimabhyarkā anāvan

paragraphs.text: 2. The Son of Angirases, meeting the cattle, as Bhaga, brought in Aryaman among us.
paragraphs.original: सं गोभिराङ्गिरसो नक्षमाणो भग इवेदर्यमणं निनाय ।
paragraphs.translit: saṃ gobhirāṅgiraso nakṣamāṇo bhaga ivedaryamaṇaṃ nināya |

paragraphs.text: As Friend of men he decks the wife and husband: as for the race, Brhaspati, nerve our coursers.
paragraphs.original: जने मित्रो न दम्पती अनक्ति बृहस्पते वाजयाशूँरिवाजौ
paragraphs.translit: jane mitro na dampatī anakti bṛhaspate vājayāśūm̐rivājau

paragraphs.text: 3. Brhaspati, having won them from the mountains, strewed down, like barley out of winnowing- baskets,
paragraphs.original: साध्वर्या अतिथिनीरिषिरा स्पार्हाः सुवर्णा अनवद्यरूपाः ।
paragraphs.translit: sādhvaryā atithinīriṣirā spārhāḥ suvarṇā anavadyarūpāḥ |

paragraphs.text: The vigorous, wandering cows who aid the pious, desired of all, of blameless form, well-coloured.
paragraphs.original: बृहस्पतिः पर्वतेभ्यो वितूर्या निर्गा ऊपे यवमिव स्थिविभ्यः
paragraphs.translit: bṛhaspatiḥ parvatebhyo vitūryā nirgā ūpe yavamiva sthivibhyaḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. As the Sun dews with meath the seat of Order, and casts a flaming meteor down from heaven.
paragraphs.original: आप्रुषायन्मधुन ऋतस्य योनिमवक्षिपन्नर्क उल्कामिव द्योः ।
paragraphs.translit: āpruṣāyanmadhuna ṛtasya yonimavakṣipannarka ulkāmiva dyoḥ |

paragraphs.text: So from the rock Brhaspati forced the cattle, and cleft the earth's skin as it were with water.
paragraphs.original: बृहस्पतिरुद्धरन्नश्मनो गा भूम्या उद्नेव वि त्वचं बिभेद
paragraphs.translit: bṛhaspatiruddharannaśmano gā bhūmyā udneva vi tvacaṃ bibheda

paragraphs.text: 5. Forth from mid air with light he drave the darkness, as the gale blows a lily from the fiver.
paragraphs.original: अप ज्योतिषा तमो अन्तरिक्षादुद्नः शीपालमिव वात आजत् ।
paragraphs.translit: apa jyotiṣā tamo antarikṣādudnaḥ śīpālamiva vāta ājat |

paragraphs.text: Like the wind grasping at the cloud of Vala, Brhaspati gathered to himself the cattle,
paragraphs.original: बृहस्पतिरनुमृश्या वलस्याभ्रमिव वात आ चक्र आ गाः
paragraphs.translit: bṛhaspatiranumṛśyā valasyābhramiva vāta ā cakra ā gāḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. Brhaspati, when he with fiery lightnings cleft through the weapon of reviling Vala,
paragraphs.original: यदा वलस्य पीयतो जसुं भेद्बृहस्पतिरग्नितपोभिरर्कैः ।
paragraphs.translit: yadā valasya pīyato jasuṃ bhedbṛhaspatiragnitapobhirarkaiḥ |

paragraphs.text: Consumed.him as tongues cat what teeth have compassed: he threw the prisons of the red cows open.
paragraphs.original: दद्भिर्न जिह्वा परिविष्टमाददाविर्निधीँरकृणोदुस्रियाणाम्
paragraphs.translit: dadbhirna jihvā pariviṣṭamādadāvirnidhīm̐rakṛṇodusriyāṇām

paragraphs.text: 7. That secret name borne by the lowing cattle within the cave Brhaspati discovered,
paragraphs.original: बृहस्पतिरमत हि त्यदासां नाम स्वरीणां सदने गुहा यत् ।
paragraphs.translit: bṛhaspatiramata hi tyadāsāṃ nāma svarīṇāṃ sadane guhā yat |

paragraphs.text: And drave, himself, the bright kine from the mountain, like a bird's young after the egg's disclosure.
paragraphs.original: आण्डेव भित्त्वा शकुनस्य गर्भमुदुस्रियाः पर्वतस्य त्मनाजत्
paragraphs.translit: āṇḍeva bhittvā śakunasya garbhamudusriyāḥ parvatasya tmanājat

paragraphs.text: 8. He looked around on rock-imprisoned sweetness as one who eyes a fish in scanty water.
paragraphs.original: अश्नापिनद्धं मधु पर्यपश्यन्मत्स्यं न दीन उदनि क्षियन्तम् ।
paragraphs.translit: aśnāpinaddhaṃ madhu paryapaśyanmatsyaṃ na dīna udani kṣiyantam |

paragraphs.text: Brhaspati, cleaving through with varied clamour, brought it forth like a bowl from out the timber.
paragraphs.original: निष्टज्जभार चमसं न वृक्षाद्बृहस्पतिर्विरवेणा विकृत्य
paragraphs.translit: niṣṭajjabhāra camasaṃ na vṛkṣādbṛhaspatirviraveṇā vikṛtya

paragraphs.text: 9. He found the light of heaven, and fire, and Morning: with lucid rays he forced apart the darkness.
paragraphs.original: सोषामविन्दत्स स्वः सो अग्निं सो अर्केण वि बबाधे तमांसि ।
paragraphs.translit: soṣāmavindatsa svaḥ so agniṃ so arkeṇa vi babādhe tamāṃsi |

paragraphs.text: As from a joint, Brhaspati took the marrow of Vala as he gloried in his cattle.
paragraphs.original: बृहस्पतिर्गोवपुषो वलस्य निर्मज्जानं न पर्वणो जभार
paragraphs.translit: bṛhaspatirgovapuṣo valasya nirmajjānaṃ na parvaṇo jabhāra

paragraphs.text: 10. As trees for foliage robbed by winter, Vala mourned for the cows Brhaspati had taken.
paragraphs.original: हिमेव पर्णा मुषिता वनानि बृहस्पतिनाकृपयद्वलो गाः ।
paragraphs.translit: himeva parṇā muṣitā vanāni bṛhaspatinākṛpayadvalo gāḥ |

paragraphs.text: He did a deed ne'er done, ne'er to be equalled, whereby the Sun and Moon ascend alternate.
paragraphs.original: अनानुकृत्यमपुनश्चकार यात्सूर्यामासा मिथ उच्चरातः
paragraphs.translit: anānukṛtyamapunaścakāra yātsūryāmāsā mitha uccarātaḥ

paragraphs.text: 11. Like a dark steed adorned with pearl, the Fathers have decorated heaven With constellations.
paragraphs.original: अभि श्यावं न कृशनेभिरश्वं नक्षत्रेभिः पितरो द्यामपिंशन् ।
paragraphs.translit: abhi śyāvaṃ na kṛśanebhiraśvaṃ nakṣatrebhiḥ pitaro dyāmapiṃśan |

paragraphs.text: They set the light in day, in night the darkness. Brhaspati cleft the rock and found the cattle.
paragraphs.original: रात्र्यां तमो अदधुर्ज्योतिरहन्बृहस्पतिर्भिनदद्रिं विदद्गाः
paragraphs.translit: rātryāṃ tamo adadhurjyotirahanbṛhaspatirbhinadadriṃ vidadgāḥ

paragraphs.text: 12. This homage have we offered to the Cloud God who thunders out to many in succession.
paragraphs.original: इदमकर्म नमो अभ्रियाय यः पूर्वीरन्वानोनवीति ।
paragraphs.translit: idamakarma namo abhriyāya yaḥ pūrvīranvānonavīti |

paragraphs.text: May this Brhaspati vouchsafe us fulness of life with kine and horses, men, and heroes.
paragraphs.original: बृहस्पतिः स हि गोभिः सो अश्वैः स वीरेभिः स नृभिर्नो वयो धात्
paragraphs.translit: bṛhaspatiḥ sa hi gobhiḥ so aśvaiḥ sa vīrebhiḥ sa nṛbhirno vayo dhāt
